changelog:
li_git1.1_checker v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Implements a two-phase document structure checker for GB/T 1.1-2020 compliance: rapid checklist scanning and in-depth standard-based review.
- Outputs structured reports highlighting issues, severity, and proposed corrections, with direct references to GB/T 1.1-2020 clauses.
- Integrates vision-based PDF page analysis to overcome text extraction issues from official standard documents.
- Supports document reviews for draft standards, enterprise/group/industry standards, quality control, and training exercises.
- Provides a detailed, itemized checklist covering required structural, content, and formatting elements per GB/T 1.1-2020.
summary: 基于 GB/T 1.1-2020 标准文档结构检查工具 — 两阶段检查（checklist快速扫描 + 标准原文深度审查），输出结构化报告
